input.command:
R --slave --vanilla << 'EOF'
# Install required packages if needed
required_packages <- c("trend", "FactoMineR")
new_packages <- required_packages[!(required_packages %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
if(length(new_packages)) install.packages(new_packages, repos="http://cran.r-project.org", quiet=TRUE)

library(trend)
library(FactoMineR)

# Load all data
water_temp <- read.csv("/root/data/water_temperature.csv")
climate <- read.csv("/root/data/climate.csv")
land_cover <- read.csv("/root/data/land_cover.csv")
hydrology <- read.csv("/root/data/hydrology.csv")

# Merge all data by Year
data <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by="Year"), 
               list(water_temp, climate, land_cover, hydrology))

# Task 1: Trend Analysis on Water Temperature
wt <- data$WaterTemperature
years <- data$Year

# Perform Mann-Kendall test (non-parametric)
mk_test <- mk.test(wt)
slope <- mk_test$estimates[1]
p_value <- mk_test$p.value

# Also perform linear regression for slope estimation
lm_model <- lm(wt ~ years)
slope_lm <- coef(lm_model)[2]

cat("Mann-Kendall Test Results:\n")
cat("Slope:", slope, "\n")
cat("P-value:", p_value, "\n\n")

# Save trend result
trend_result <- data.frame(slope = slope, p.value = p_value)
write.csv(trend_result, "/root/output/trend_result.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Task 2: Identify most important driving factor
# Define factor categories
factors_heat <- c("AirTempLake", "Shortwave", "Longwave")
factors_flow <- c("Inflow", "Outflow")
factors_wind <- c("WindSpeedLake")
factors_human <- c("DevelopedArea", "AgricultureArea")

# Select relevant columns for analysis
response <- data$WaterTemperature
predictors <- data[, c(factors_heat, factors_flow, factors_wind, factors_human)]

# Perform PCA on predictors
pca_result <- PCA(predictors, scale.unit = TRUE, graph = FALSE)

# Perform linear regression with all predictors
full_model <- lm(response ~ ., data = data.frame(response = response, predictors))

# Calculate R-squared contributions using R2 decomposition
library(ggplot2)
R2_full <- summary(full_model)$r.squared

# Calculate contribution of each variable
contributions <- numeric(ncol(predictors))
names(contributions) <- colnames(predictors)

for (i in 1:ncol(predictors)) {
  model_without <- lm(response ~ ., data = data.frame(response = response, predictors[, -i]))
  R2_without <- summary(model_without)$r.squared
  contributions[i] <- max(0, (R2_full - R2_without) / R2_full * 100)
}

# Classify contributions by factor category
heat_contrib <- sum(contributions[factors_heat])
flow_contrib <- sum(contributions[factors_flow])
wind_contrib <- sum(contributions[factors_wind])
human_contrib <- sum(contributions[factors_human])

cat("\nFactor Category Contributions:\n")
cat("Heat:", heat_contrib, "%\n")
cat("Flow:", flow_contrib, "%\n")
cat("Wind:", wind_contrib, "%\n")
cat("Human:", human_contrib, "%\n\n")

# Find dominant category
categories <- c("Heat", "Flow", "Wind", "Human")
category_contribs <- c(heat_contrib, flow_contrib, wind_contrib, human_contrib)
dominant_idx <- which.max(category_contribs)
dominant_category <- categories[dominant_idx]

# Find most important variable in dominant category
if (dominant_category == "Heat") {
  dominant_vars <- factors_heat
} else if (dominant_category == "Flow") {
  dominant_vars <- factors_flow
} else if (dominant_category == "Wind") {
  dominant_vars <- factors_wind
} else {
  dominant_vars <- factors_human
}

var_contribs <- contributions[dominant_vars]
most_important_var <- names(which.max(var_contribs))
most_important_contrib <- var_contribs[which.max(var_contribs)]

cat("Dominant Factor Category:", dominant_category, "\n")
cat("Most Important Variable:", most_important_var, "\n")
cat("Contribution:", most_important_contrib, "%\n\n")

# Save dominant factor result
dominant_factor <- data.frame(
  variable = most_important_var,
  contribution = most_important_contrib
)
write.csv(dominant_factor, "/root/output/dominant_factor.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("Results saved successfully!\n")
EOF

python3 << 'EOF'
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
import os

# Ensure output directory exists
os.makedirs("/root/output", exist_ok=True)

# Load all data
water_temp = pd.read_csv("/root/data/water_temperature.csv")
climate = pd.read_csv("/root/data/climate.csv")
land_cover = pd.read_csv("/root/data/land_cover.csv")
hydrology = pd.read_csv("/root/data/hydrology.csv")

# Merge all data by Year
data = water_temp.merge(climate, on="Year").merge(land_cover, on="Year").merge(hydrology, on="Year")

print("Data shape:", data.shape)
print("\nData columns:", data.columns.tolist())

# Task 1: Trend Analysis on Water Temperature
years = data["Year"].values
water_temps = data["WaterTemperature"].values

# Perform linear regression for trend
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(years, water_temps)

print("\n=== TREND ANALYSIS RESULTS ===")
print(f"Slope: {slope}")
print(f"P-value: {p_value}")
print(f"R-squared: {r_value**2}")

# Save trend result
trend_result = pd.DataFrame({
    "slope": [slope],
    "p.value": [p_value]
})
trend_result.to_csv("/root/output/trend_result.csv", index=False)
print("\nTrend result saved to /root/output/trend_result.csv")

# Task 2: Identify most important driving factor
# Define factor categories
factors_heat = ["AirTempLake", "Shortwave", "Longwave"]
factors_flow = ["Inflow", "Outflow"]
factors_wind = ["WindSpeedLake"]
factors_human = ["DevelopedArea", "AgricultureArea"]

all_factors = factors_heat + factors_flow + factors_wind + factors_human

# Prepare response and predictor variables
y = data["WaterTemperature"].values
X = data[all_factors].values

# Standardize predictors
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)

# Fit linear regression model
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X_scaled, y)

# Calculate R-squared
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score
y_pred = model.predict(X_scaled)
r2_full = r2_score(y, y_pred)

print("\n=== FACTOR CONTRIBUTION ANALYSIS ===")
print(f"Full model R-squared: {r2_full}")

# Calculate contribution of each variable
contributions = {}
for i, var_name in enumerate(all_factors):
    # Create X without this variable
    X_without = np.delete(X_scaled, i, axis=1)
    model_without = LinearRegression()
    model_without.fit(X_without, y)
    y_pred_without = model_without.predict(X_without)
    r2_without = r2_score(y, y_pred_without)
    
    # Contribution as percentage of R2
    contrib = max(0, (r2_full - r2_without) / r2_full * 100)
    contributions[var_name] = contrib

# Classify contributions by factor category
heat_contrib = sum(contributions[v] for v in factors_heat)
flow_contrib = sum(contributions[v] for v in factors_flow)
wind_contrib = sum(contributions[v] for v in factors_wind)
human_contrib = sum(contributions[v] for v in factors_human)

print(f"\nFactor Category Contributions:")
print(f"Heat: {heat_contrib:.2f}%")
print(f"Flow: {flow_contrib:.2f}%")
print(f"Wind: {wind_contrib:.2f}%")
print(f"Human: {human_contrib:.2f}%")

# Find dominant category
category_contribs = {
    "Heat": heat_contrib,
    "Flow": flow_contrib,
    "Wind": wind_contrib,
    "Human": human_contrib
}
dominant_category = max(category_contribs, key=category_contribs.get)

# Find most important variable in dominant category
if dominant_category == "Heat":
    dominant_vars = factors_heat
elif dominant_category == "Flow":
    dominant_vars = factors_flow
elif dominant_category == "Wind":
    dominant_vars = factors_wind
else:
    dominant_vars = factors_human

most_important_var = max(dominant_vars, key=lambda v: contributions[v])
most_important_contrib = contributions[most_important_var]

print(f"\nDominant Factor Category: {dominant_category}")
print(f"Most Important Variable: {most_important_var}")
print(f"Contribution: {most_important_contrib:.2f}%")

# Save dominant factor result
dominant_factor = pd.DataFrame({
    "variable": [most_important_var],
    "contribution": [most_important_contrib]
})
dominant_factor.to_csv("/root/output/dominant_factor.csv", index=False)
print("\nDominant factor result saved to /root/output/dominant_factor.csv")

# Print all variable contributions for reference
print("\n=== ALL VARIABLE CONTRIBUTIONS ===")
for var, contrib in sorted(contributions.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True):
    print(f"{var}: {contrib:.2f}%")

EOF
